visual_action: A slideshow of split-screen images comparing Kamala Harris and Donald Trump at different points in time. Each slide features a photo of Harris on top and Trump on the bottom, with text overlays describing their alleged accomplishments or problems for a specific year (1990, 2002, 2012, 2015, 2016, and 'The 2020s').

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Her face appears in photos throughout the video, and on-screen text identifies her by name and details her career milestones.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: His face appears in photos throughout the video, and on-screen text identifies him by name and details his alleged legal and financial issues.

on_screen_text.text: Kamala Harris and Donald Trump over the years
Hired as a deputy district attorney in Alameda County
Became the 1st person of color elected San Francisco DA
Had 20 pending lawsuits related to tax violations/evasion
As AG, won back $18B for homeowners from big banks
Was under investigation for running a scam university
Sued energy companies over violating pollution laws
Was elected to the U.S. Senate
Misused donations intended for charities for his campaign
As VP, got the Inflation Reduction Act passed, capped the cost of insulin for seniors, & more
Lied about it for 4 years straight

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it is accompanied only by music.
audio_music: A slowed, reverb-heavy hip-hop track ('If We Being Real' by Hypex) with a serious and dramatic tone plays consistently throughout the video.
editing_pacing: The video is a slideshow with a slow, deliberate pace. It consists of static, split-screen images with simple cuts between them.
central_claim: Kamala Harris has a history of commendable public service and achievements, while Donald Trump has a contrasting history of financial issues, legal troubles, and alleged fraud.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers to admire Kamala Harris's record while feeling contempt and disapproval for Donald Trump's past actions.
